from: August book, night 14 (Esther Saves Her People)
p1: Esther made a big, special dinner for the king and Haman. The king asked, “Queen Esther, what do you want? I will give it to you.”
Esther said, “Please save my life and my people. Someone has a plan to hurt us all.”
The king asked, “Who would do this?” Esther said, “It is this bad man, Haman.” And Haman’s plan was stopped.
p2: Then Esther’s people had light and joy! Their sad days turned into happy days. They had feasts and sent gifts to each other and to the poor. They called these days Purim.
Esther helped save her people. Jesus came to save us all. His love can turn sad days into happy ones. Tonight, think of something you could share.
old: At the second dinner, the moment was finally right. Brave Queen Esther spoke the truth to the king. “Please save me and my people,” she said. “A wicked plan has been made to hurt us.” The king asked, “Who would do such a thing?” Esther answered, “It is Haman.”
The king was very upset with proud Haman. He stopped Haman’s wicked plan right away and kept Esther and her people safe.
Because Esther was brave and told the truth, Heavenly Father’s people were saved! Speaking the truth, even when it’s hard, can help and protect the people we love.
